name: xView1: Large-Scale Overhead Object Detection Challenge Dataset
description: xView1 is a large-scale overhead and satellite imagery dataset for object detection released by the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) and the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA). Spanning more than 1,415 km² across globally diverse areas, it features 0.3-meter ground sample distance (GSD) imagery collected from DigitalGlobe WorldView-3 satellites. The dataset contains over one million bounding box annotations across 60 fine-grained object categories hierarchically organized into passenger vehicles, maritime vessels, aircraft, railway equipment, trucks, and engineering infrastructure. The official public release comprises 847 large training satellite scenes with public ground-truth annotations and 282 held-out validation scenes (1,129 scenes total), specifically targeting small and dense object detection in complex overhead context.

verification.notes: Verified against DIU xView challenge portal, official DIUx GitHub repository (DIUx-xView/data_utilities), and foundational arXiv:1802.07856 paper. Confirmed original release composition of 847 training scenes and 282 validation scenes (1,129 large GeoTIFF satellite scenes total) spanning 1,415 km² of geographic area with >1M bounding boxes across 60 classes under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Clarified that 1,415 reflects square kilometers of geographic surface coverage rather than an image or tile count.

size.notes: Compressed archive payload containing 1,129 large 3-band 8-bit GeoTIFF scenes (847 training scenes, 282 validation scenes, typically ~3300x3300 pixels) and GeoJSON bounding box annotations, covering >1,415 km² of geographic area. 1,415 represents square kilometers of geographic surface coverage, not the scene or tile count.

provenance.curation_notes: Annotated by professional imagery analysts. Bounding boxes are formatted as pixel coordinates within large GeoTIFF scenes; sample count tracks original multi-kilometer satellite scenes rather than cropped network chips.
